parts.t: Welcome to Parkview Place in Central Port Coquitlam. Featuring 970 sq. ft. of open living space, this 2-bed, 2-bath home, with the second bedroom not having a window, offers a bright, open floor plan. This updated ground-floor condo features 9 ft. ceilings, in-suite laundry, a cozy gas fireplace, and access to a private 12x11 deck from the living room and primary bedroom. The renovated kitchen offers ceiling-height cabinets, generous counter space, and great storage. Freshly painted with new designer fixtures and updated modern plugs. Maintenance includes gas and heat. Close to Gates Park, Traboulay PoCo Trail, shopping, schools, West Coast Express, transit, and Highway 1. Includes 1 parking stall and 1 storage locker.
